These pages appear under the **Server** section of Looker's Admin menu:

  * [IP Allowlist](/looker/docs/admin-panel-server-ip-allowlist): Configure a list of IP addresses that can access your Looker instance. (The IP allowlist is available only for Looker-hosted instances. Customer-hosted instances will not see this option in the **Admin** panel.)
  * [Log](/looker/docs/admin-panel-server-log): View the 500 most recent system log messages generated by your Looker instance.
  * [Usage](/looker/docs/admin-panel-server-usage): Review usage information about your Looker instance in a Looker-created dashboard.
